title: Title save wipes unsaved body text typed in the same second (editor reset to stale server content)
repro: Docs > open any tiptap page (e.g. QA-q9 'Untitled' d76ea8b4)
Click the title input, type 'Race' (title save debounced 1000 ms)
Immediately click the body, press Enter and keep typing 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' at ~90 ms/key
Wait 3 s and read the body / GET the page
expected: Everything typed in the body is kept; a title save never touches body content
actual: When PATCH /meta returns (~1 s) PageEditor calls onPageChange(updated) and the SSE meta_updated event triggers refreshPage(); both replace page.content_json with the server copy, and TiptapEditor's initialContent effect calls setContent() with it, wiping the new paragraph and the first 11 characters ('\nabcdefghijk'). Remaining keystrokes land in the stale paragraph. Final saved content: 'Body text that should persist ZZZlmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' (paragraph break + 'abcdefghijk' lost).

network: #322 GET /pages/d76ea8b4… 200 (SSE-triggered refresh while body edits unsaved)

codeRefs.note: onPageChange(updated) replaces page (incl. stale content_json) after a title-only save
meta_updated SSE event without requestId -> refreshPage() while idle
any initialContent change != editor JSON -> setContent(), discarding local edits

suggestedFix: Only push server content into the editor when the page id changes or when a remote content_updated event arrives AND no local edit is pending; after a title save merge only title/updated_at into page state (setPage(p => ({...p, title, updated_at}))). Pass requestId on meta PATCH and ignore own meta events, or make handlePageUpdate skip 'meta_updated'.

title: Page title edits are silently dropped when switching page or leaving Docs within 1 s; no save feedback for titles
repro: Docs > New page (editor header +)
Type 'QA-q9-title-loss' in the title
Within ~300 ms click another page in the tree (QA-q9-mention-target)
Wait 2.5 s; GET /api/modules/knowledge/workspaces/default/tree
expected: Pending title is flushed (like body content, which useAutosave flushes on switch) and a Saving…/Saved indicator covers title edits
actual: Tree/API still show 'Untitled'; no PATCH /meta was sent. The title debounce timer is cleared on pageId change and on unmount. The Saving…/Saved pill only tracks body content — a title edit shows nothing (MutationObserver log over 3 s: no status change).

network: no PATCH /pages/d76ea8b4…/meta after the title fill

codeRefs.note: pageId effect clears titleTimerRef without flushing
unmount clears title timer without flushing
status pill driven only by content autosave

suggestedFix: Keep the pending title in a ref and flush (fire the PATCH) on pageId change/unmount/blur/Enter instead of clearTimeout; route title saves through the same status pill (Saving…/Saved/Error).

title: Page tree does not refresh after New page (sidebar +), Add subpage, Delete from tree, or drag-move
repro: Docs with 0 pages: click the sidebar header '+' (New page) -> editor opens 'Untitled' but the sidebar still says 'No pages yet'
Hover QA-q9-parent > Add subpage -> child is created (API tree shows it) and opened, but the tree shows no child/chevron
Hover a page > Delete > accept -> DELETE 204, row stays in the tree; clicking it shows raw 'PAGE_NOT_FOUND'
Drag QA-q9-B onto the lower quarter of QA-q9-mention-target (or drag C into parent) -> POST /move 200, tree order unchanged until reload
expected: Tree reflects every create/delete/move immediately (it already does for title edits and imports, which call requestRefresh)
actual: Only title saves, editor-header New page, editor Delete and import call requestRefresh(); Sidebar.handleCreatePage, PageTree.handleCreate, TreeItem.handleCreateChild/handleDelete/handleDrop never refresh. Tree is stale until reload or an unrelated title edit.

console: 404 GET /pages/945437d3… after clicking the stale deleted row

suggestedFix: Call useTreeStore.getState().requestRefresh() after every successful create/delete/move in Sidebar, PageTree and TreeItem (or have the SSE page-event handler in Space.tsx request a tree refresh for created/deleted/moved/meta_updated events). Also clear selection when the selected page is deleted from the tree.

title: Page tree order is scrambled: tree sorts order keys with localeCompare but keys are ASCII base62
repro: Create pages in this order: QA-q9-mention-target (key 'V'), QA-q9-parent ('k'), QA-q9-B ('s'), QA-q9-C ('w')
Observe tree: parent, B, mention-target, C — the 2nd page appears above the 1st
Drag QA-q9-B onto the lower quarter of QA-q9-mention-target ('after')
Reload Docs
expected: New pages append at the end; 'drop after X' puts the page directly after X
actual: Tree order after the drop is B, parent, mention-target — B jumped to the TOP (backend assigned key 'c' between 'V' and 'k' in binary order, but localeCompare sorts 'c' before 'k' and 'V' after 's'). Order depends on letter case of generated keys.

codeRefs.note: ALPHABET 0-9A-Za-z (ASCII order); siblings for key generation use SQL binary ORDER BY

suggestedFix: Sort with a binary comparison (a.order_key < b.order_key ? -1 : a.order_key > b.order_key ? 1 : 0) in buildTree, matching SQLite's default BINARY collation used everywhere else.

title: Editor toolbar active/disabled states go stale (Bold stays highlighted outside bold text; Undo/Redo lag)
repro: Docs > QA-q9-B, type 'alpha beta gamma', double-click 'beta', click Bold
Click at the very start of 'alpha' (plain text) and wait 1.5 s
Observe the Bold toolbar button
expected: Bold/Italic/Heading/etc. reflect the mark/node at the caret; Undo/Redo disabled state follows history
actual: Bold stays highlighted (bg-accent-soft) with the caret in plain text; immediately after clicking Bold the button is NOT highlighted. Undo/Redo disabled state only updates when some unrelated React state changes (autosave status), e.g. Redo reported disabled right after 4 undos.

codeRefs.note: editor.isActive()/can() read at render time; nothing re-renders on selectionUpdate/transaction

suggestedFix: In FixedToolbar use useEditorState({ editor, selector: e => ({ bold: e.isActive('bold'), …, canUndo: e.can().undo(), canRedo: e.can().redo() }) }) from @tiptap/react so the toolbar re-renders on transactions only. Also add aria-pressed={active} to ToolbarButton.

title: Task list renders broken: bullet + checkbox on one line, item text on the next
repro: Docs > any page, click Task list (or type '[ ] ') and type an item
Observe the rendered item
expected: Checkbox and item text inline on one row, no list bullet (standard task list)
actual: The <ul data-type=taskList> gets prose list-disc bullets; the <label> and <div> inside the <li> stack vertically, so the row shows a grey bullet + checkbox and the text drops to the next line.
suggestedFix: Add editor CSS: .ProseMirror ul[data-type=taskList]{list-style:none;padding-left:0} ul[data-type=taskList] li{display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:flex-start} li>label{margin-top:.2rem} li>div{flex:1} li>div>p{margin:0}; style the checkbox with accent-color: var(--selection).

title: Editor prose uses Tailwind Typography default gray (blue-slate cast) and adds literal backticks around inline code
repro: Docs > page with a blockquote, horizontal rule ('---'), bullet list and `inline code`
Pixel-probe the quote bar / hr / bullets
expected: Neutral token colours (--border/--divider/--text-tertiary); inline code shown as a chip without literal backticks
actual: Blockquote bar and <hr> are #364153 (Tailwind gray-700, blue cast, dE 12.8 from nearest token), list markers #4a5565 (gray-600, blue cast); the theme remaps slate/violet but not the prose 'gray' palette. Inline code renders as `code span` with visible backtick glyphs (prose code::before/::after), and quotes get auto curly quotes + italic. Light theme: code block background #1e2939 (gray-800 navy), body text #364153 and headings #101828 (blue-gray instead of --text #26262b/--text-strong #111114); task checkbox uses the browser's default blue accent.

codeRefs.note: class 'prose prose-sm dark:prose-invert' -> default gray theme

suggestedFix: Use 'prose prose-neutral' and map --tw-prose-body/headings/bullets/hr/quote-borders/code/pre-bg (and --tw-prose-invert-*) to the design tokens in index.css; add prose-code:before:content-none prose-code:after:content-none and style inline code with --surface-raised.

title: App white-screens when opening a text page after a PDF page or after deleting the open page (FixedToolbar uses destroyed Tiptap editor)
repro: Path A (most common): Docs > open any text page (e.g. QA-q9-sample-txt), then click a PDF page (QA-q9-sample-pdf) — viewer renders — then click any text page again
Path B: open QA-q9-B, click editor header '+' (New page), click 'Delete page' and accept the confirm, then click QA-q9-B in the tree
expected: QA-q9-B opens normally
actual: Entire app goes blank (#root innerHTML length 0, playwright snapshot empty) in both paths. Console: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading \'can\') at FixedToolbar (FixedToolbar.tsx:70)' + 'An error occurred in the <FixedToolbar> component'. Reload required. Also reproduced during exploration after deleting a page and opening a search result. Reproduced in light theme too (QA-q9-sample-md -> QA-q9-sample-pdf -> QA-q9-B: #root length 0).

console: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'can') at FixedToolbar (src/modules/knowledge/frontend/components/Editor/FixedToolbar.tsx:70:27)
An error occurred in the <FixedToolbar> component. Consider adding an error boundary…

codeRefs.note: editor kept in state; never reset when TiptapEditor unmounts/destroys it
{editor && !pdfData && <FixedToolbar editor={editor}/>} renders with the destroyed instance while the next page loads

suggestedFix: Reset the editor state when TiptapEditor unmounts (onReady(null) in the destroy cleanup, or setEditor(null) in PageEditor when pageId changes / page is null / pdfData), and guard FixedToolbar/LinkDialog with !editor.isDestroyed. Add an error boundary around module spaces (K01) so a Docs render error cannot blank the whole app.

title: Single click on a link in the editor opens it in a new window (duplicate Link extension overrides openOnClick:false)
repro: Docs > QA-q9-C, select 'ordered', Link > https://example.com > Enter
Click once on the linked word to place the caret/edit it
expected: Caret is placed in the link (openOnClick:false is configured); links open only on an explicit action
actual: A new tab/window to https://example.com opens on every plain click (context pages 1 -> 2), making link text practically uneditable with the mouse. Console on every editor mount: '[tiptap warn]: Duplicate extension names found: [\'link\']'. StarterKit 3.27.1 already registers Link with openOnClick:true; the separately added Link.configure({openOnClick:false}) loses.

console: [tiptap warn]: Duplicate extension names found: ['link']. This can lead to issues.

suggestedFix: Configure the bundled one: StarterKit.configure({ heading: { levels: [1,2,3] }, link: { openOnClick: false, autolink: true } }) and remove the separate Link import (same for markdown import generateJSON which shares this list). Optionally support Cmd/Ctrl+click to open via the app's external-link handler.

title: Link dialog: Save with a collapsed caret silently does nothing; Esc drops focus to <body>; Remove always shown
repro: Docs > QA-q9-C, click at end of 'md bullet' (no selection)
Click Link, type https://nothing.example, press Enter
Open Link again on an existing link and press Esc, then type
expected: With no selection the URL is inserted as linked text (or Link is disabled with a hint); after Esc/Cancel focus returns to the editor at the previous selection; 'Remove' only when a link exists
actual:
Enter closes the dialog and nothing is inserted, no feedback (html unchanged '

md bullet

'). After Esc document.activeElement is BODY, so typing goes nowhere. 'Remove' button is always rendered. Radix warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' on each open; the URL input has no label (placeholder only).

codeRefs.note: setLink on empty selection is a no-op
no onCloseAutoFocus -> focus not returned to editor; no DialogDescription

suggestedFix: If editor.state.selection.empty: insertContent({type:'text', text:url, marks:[{type:'link', attrs:{href:url}}]}); add onCloseAutoFocus={e=>{e.preventDefault(); editor.commands.focus();}}; render Remove only when editor.isActive('link'); add aria-label='Link URL' and a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined}).

title: Failed body save shows a bare 'Error' pill, never retries, and the edit is silently discarded on page switch
repro: route '**/api/modules/knowledge/pages/*/content' -> 500
Docs > QA-q9-sample-txt, type ' unsaved-edit' -> pill shows 'Error'
unroute (backend healthy again), wait 4 s
Click QA-q9-B then back to QA-q9-sample-txt
expected: Clear message ('Couldn't save — retrying…' / Retry action), automatic retry with backoff once the backend is reachable, and a warning/flush before leaving a page with unsaved changes
actual: Pill reads only 'Error' (no tooltip/cause/retry). No retry happens after the backend recovers (GET page still 'Plain text QA sample.'). Switching pages resets pending state and the edit 'unsaved-edit' is gone. Same for 409 conflicts (PageContentConflictError is thrown and just shows 'Error'). Same with network offline (light theme): 'Error' pill, and after going back online for 5 s the text ' offline-edit' is still not saved.

console: Failed to save page content: KnowledgeApiError: boom
network: GET /pages/{txt} after switch -> content without the edit

codeRefs.note: catch -> status 'error', pending content already cleared, no retry

suggestedFix: In useAutosave keep the failed content as pending and schedule retries (e.g. 2s/5s/15s) and on 'online'/visibility; expose the error message; render 'Not saved — Retry' as a button; on page switch with pending/failed content flush or warn. Handle 409 by offering reload/overwrite.

title: Docs failures are silent or show raw codes: import/create/delete/move errors only console.error; tree error shows 'HTTP_500' in raw red
repro: Import document > choose a .pdf that is not a PDF (QA-q9-fake.pdf) -> backend 400 'File is not a PDF (missing %PDF- header)'
route POST '**/api/modules/knowledge/pages' -> 500, click New page
route '**/workspaces/default/tree' -> 500, reload, open Docs
Click a deleted-but-still-listed tree row (see Q9-003)
expected: Human-readable inline error/toast ('Couldn't import QA-q9-fake.pdf: not a valid PDF'), token-coloured, with Retry where relevant
actual: Import and create failures: no UI feedback at all (only console 'Failed to import document: KnowledgeApiError: File is not a PDF…', 'Failed to create page: KnowledgeApiError: boom'); spinner stops and nothing happens. Delete/move failures likewise only console.error. Tree load failure shows 'HTTP_500' + 'Retry' in raw text-red-600 (#e6000b, dE 21.7 from nearest token; --status-danger is #e0705f). Page load failure shows raw 'PAGE_NOT_FOUND'. Offline: New page click does nothing and shows nothing.

console: Failed to import document: KnowledgeApiError: File is not a PDF (missing %PDF- header)
Failed to create page: KnowledgeApiError: boom

codeRefs.note: text-red-600, raw error code, hand-rolled Retry button
code falls back to `HTTP_${status}` and is used as the message

suggestedFix: Map KnowledgeApiError codes to copy (PAGE_NOT_FOUND -> 'This page was deleted', HTTP_5xx -> 'Couldn't load pages'); surface failures via the app notice/toast kit (or an inline status-danger banner in the sidebar); use text-status-danger and the kit Button for Retry.

title: Docs page tree is not keyboard operable: rows unfocusable, chevrons nameless, row actions focusable while invisible, ghost buttons show no focus
repro: Docs, focus the Search field, press Tab repeatedly
Watch document.activeElement and the screen
expected: Tree is a role=tree/treeitem list: Tab into it, arrows move, Enter opens, Right/Left expand/collapse, row actions revealed on focus; every focused control has a visible ring
actual: Tab order: Import document, New page, then per row: nameless BUTTON (chevron, present even on leaf rows where it does nothing), 'Add subpage' (opacity 0), 'Delete' (opacity 0). Page rows themselves (div onClick) can never be focused, so a page cannot be opened from the keyboard. Focused kit ghost buttons (Import/New page/toolbar) have border 0 + outline none -> no visible focus indicator (focus-visible:border-selection needs a border).

codeRefs.note: row is a div with onClick; no tabIndex/role/onKeyDown
chevron button has no aria-label/aria-expanded, rendered for leaves
ghost variant focus-visible:border-selection with no border -> invisible

suggestedFix: Render rows as role=treeitem (aria-level/aria-expanded/aria-selected) with roving tabIndex and key handling (Up/Down/Left/Right/Enter/Delete); aria-label the chevron ('Expand <title>') and omit it for leaves; add group-focus-within:opacity-100 to the actions; give the kit ghost button a focus-visible ring (outline/box-shadow using --selection).

title: Editor meta line is stale: word count carries over from the previous page and 'edited Xm ago' never updates after saves
repro: Open QA-q9-parent (6 words), then hover it > Add subpage (new empty page opens)
Read the meta line under the title
Type in any page, wait for 'Saved', read 'edited …'
expected: Empty new page shows '0 words'; 'edited just now' after each save
actual: New empty page shows '6 words' (previous page's count; also '5 words' after other switches) — setContent(emitUpdate:false) never fires 'update'. 'edited 3m ago' / '4m ago' shown on pages edited seconds earlier because page.updated_at is not refreshed after content saves.

codeRefs.note: word count only recomputed on editor 'update'
save result updated_at kept in a ref only, page state not updated

suggestedFix: Recompute word count on 'update' AND after setContent (or listen to 'transaction'); after a successful content save update page.updated_at in state (without touching content_json) and re-render the relative time periodically.

title: Docs search field is a 32px hand-rolled input (kit search fields are 22px in a 34px header)
repro: Open Home, Library and Docs; measure the search inputs
expected: Same kit SearchField as Home/Library: 22px control, 11px text, inside the 34px module header
actual: Docs 'Search...' input is 32px tall, 12px text, own border/violet focus ring, inside a 48px (p-2) bar; Home 'Search designs…' and Library 'Search name, MPN, package…' use a 22px wrapper in a 34px header. Link dialog URL input is likewise hand-rolled (px-3 py-2, ~34px). DOM census docs-editor-dark-1440: oddControls [{h:32}].

codeRefs.note: h-8 input with border-slate-300 focus:border-violet-500 focus:ring-violet-500

suggestedFix: Replace both with the shared kit input/SearchField (src/shared/frontend/ui) used by HomeScreen/Library header; add aria-label='Search pages'.

title: Docs (and Tasks) still use raw palette classes and hand-rolled controls instead of tokens/kit
repro: grep the knowledge frontend for slate-/violet-/red-/bg-white/rounded-md
Compare rendered colours with tokens (pixel probes)
expected: Semantic tokens (border-border, bg-surface-hover, text-status-danger, bg-selection …) and kit components only
actual: Knowledge module: border-slate-200/800 on every divider, hover:bg-slate-100/800 rows, focus:border-violet-500/ring-violet-500 search, drop indicators bg-violet-500, skeleton bg-slate-200/800 rounded-md, error text-red-600 (#e6000b, dE 21.7) + hand-rolled Retry, LinkDialog bg-white/text-slate-900/dark:bg-slate-800, PdfViewer well bg-slate-100/900, toolbar dividers bg-slate-200/700, status pill bg-slate-100. Most render close to tokens only because index.css remaps slate/violet to neutrals (e.g. dividers #1c1c1f vs --border #1e1e21), so they will drift the moment the remap changes; red and the prose 'gray' palette are visibly off (see Q9-007, Q9-012). Tasks space is entirely raw (see Q9-019).
suggestedFix: Swap to token utilities (border-border, bg-surface-hover, bg-selection for drop lines, text-status-danger, bg-surface-canvas-well or surface-section for the PDF well) and kit Input/Button; delete dark: pairs that tokens already handle.

title: Docs layout ignores shell metrics: no 34px module header, 36px tree rows, inverted surfaces, misaligned header borders, 3 'New page' CTAs
repro: Open Docs next to Home/Library in dark theme
Measure/probe
expected: Like Home/Library: 34px header with title + count and search, 22px rows at 11-12px, side panel --surface-panel, main --surface-app, one primary create action
actual: No module header/title; sidebar top bar 48px while the editor title block is 58px, so the two bottom borders are offset by 10px; tree rows 36px (py-1.5), editor font 14px. Sidebar is --surface-app (#0c0c0d) and the editor --surface-panel (#111113) — the reverse of Home/Library (side #111113, main #0c0c0d, header #0f0f10). Empty Docs shows three 'New page' buttons at once (header '+', sidebar card, editor card). Search results rows (48px, breadcrumb repeats the page's own title) differ from tree rows. Page body column (max-w 46rem centred) does not align with the left-aligned title.

codeRefs.note: p-2 top bar, no module header

suggestedFix: Adopt the shared module header (34px: 'Docs' + 'N pages' + search + Import/New page), 22px tree rows, sidebar bg-surface-panel / editor bg-surface-app; align sidebar and editor header heights; drop the empty-state duplicate CTAs (keep one); left-align title with the body column; omit breadcrumb when it equals the title.

title: Docs forgets the open page and tree expansion when leaving the module or reloading; search results don't reveal nested pages
repro: Docs > open QA-q9-B (QA-q9-parent expanded)
Click Library in the rail, then Docs again (or reload)
Search 'q9-C' and click the nested result
expected: Last page re-opens with its tree branch expanded (as Designer tabs persist); opening a nested search result expands and highlights it in the tree
actual: Returns to 'No page selected' with every branch collapsed after a module switch or reload. Selecting a nested search result opens it but the parent stays collapsed, so the page is not visible/highlighted in the tree (expandAncestors exists in tree-store but is never called).
suggestedFix: Persist selectedPageId + expandedIds (per scope) in localStorage (try/catch) or the navigation store params; call expandAncestors(pageId) whenever a page is selected. This also gives K22's @page mention navigation a place to land.

title: Docs search only matches titles — body text and imported .md/.txt content are not searchable
repro: Page QA-q9-C contains the words 'md ordered' in its body
Type 'ordered' in the Docs 'Search...' field
expected: Pages whose content contains the term are found (or the field says 'Search titles')
actual: 'No pages found for "ordered"'. Backend SearchService.searchByTitle does LIKE on title only (also unescaped % and _ wildcards). Imported documents are therefore unfindable by content.
suggestedFix: Index plain text of tiptap content (and PDF text if extracted) with SQLite FTS5 and search title+body; until then change the placeholder to 'Search page titles…'.

title: At 1100 px the editor meta line wraps ('edited 3m / ago', '0 / words') when a breadcrumb is present
repro: resize 1100x720
Docs > expand 'QA-q9-long Title…' > open child 'QA-q9-child of long'
expected: Breadcrumb truncates; 'edited …' and word count stay on one line; header height stays constant
actual: Breadcrumb takes the width and the trailing spans wrap onto two lines, growing the header from 58px to ~74px and pushing the toolbar down.

codeRefs.note: meta spans lack whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0; breadcrumb span needs min-w-0

suggestedFix: Give the breadcrumb span 'min-w-0 truncate' inside a 'min-w-0 flex' row and mark the other spans 'shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap'; make breadcrumb segments clickable links to the ancestor pages.

title: Tasks module is unreachable from the UI (hidden from rail; no menu/shortcut)
repro: Look at the left rail, Settings, context menu and command surfaces for 'Tasks'
Only eval navigateToModule('tasks') opens it
expected: Either a deliberate entry point (rail 'system' group, Settings > Diagnostics, or a status-bar background-work indicator) or the module is not shipped
actual: manifest sidebar.hidden:true; rail shows Home/Designer/Library/Docs/Assistant only; the space renders only via the navigation store. When shown, no rail item is highlighted.
suggestedFix: Decide: expose as a background-activity popover (status bar) or Settings > Diagnostics page reusing kit table styles, or drop the frontend entry until designed. Do not un-hide before Q9-022/Q9-023 are fixed.

title: Tasks space white-screens the app when /tasks returns an error JSON (tasks.map is not a function)
repro: route '**/api/modules/tasks/tasks*' -> 500 application/problem+json {"type":"about:blank","title":"Internal error","status":500}
eval navigateToModule('tasks')
expected: Error message with Retry; app keeps working
actual: #root becomes empty (innerHTML length 0); console 'TypeError: tasks.map is not a function'. The fetch never checks response.ok and stores the problem object as the task array. Rated S2 only because the space is currently hidden (K42); it is S1 once reachable.

console: TypeError: tasks.map is not a function

codeRefs.note: .then(response => response.json()) without ok check; setTasks(data) with non-array

suggestedFix: if (!response.ok) throw new Error(problem.title ?? `Couldn't load tasks (${status})`); guard Array.isArray(data); add the module error boundary (K01).

title: Tasks list is clipped (36 of 50 rows unreachable), has no loading state, and is styled with raw palette (light-pink error box in dark theme)
repro: eval navigateToModule('tasks') on stack A (50 tasks)
Scroll the list with the mouse wheel
Make /tasks return invalid JSON (route body 'not json') and reload the space
expected: Scrollable dense table (22px rows: type, status chip, created/duration, id), 'Loading…' while fetching, token-coloured error with Retry, no 'No tasks yet' under an error
actual: List container is overflow-hidden inside a non-scrolling h-full column: scrollHeight 2799 vs 790 visible, wheel does nothing, rows 15-50 unreachable. Before data arrives it says 'No tasks yet.' (no loading state). Error shows the raw exception ('Unexpected token \'o\', "not json" is not valid JSON') in a bg-red-50 box that stays light pink (#fef2f2) in dark theme, text #c40d14 (dE 19.2), and 'No tasks yet.' still renders below it. Rows show only type + raw UUID + status (no timestamps/duration, no status colour), 56px tall, rounded-xl/rounded-lg containers, text-xl title — none of the kit metrics. No refresh/live update (SSE route exists).

pixelProbes.nearestToken: --surface-input (list uses bg-white instead of a surface token)

codeRefs.note: flex h-full flex-col p-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 — no overflow-auto
border-red-300 bg-red-50 text-red-700 without dark variants
'No tasks yet.' also shown while loading/after error

suggestedFix: Rebuild with the shared module header + kit table (min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-auto), status chips via --status-* tokens, relative timestamps, loading/empty/error states from the kit, subscribe to the tasks SSE stream or add a Refresh button.

title: Clearing a page title saves an empty title: tree shows a blank, unlabeled row; Enter in the title does nothing
repro: Docs > QA-q9-sample-md, select the title and delete all text
Wait 1.5 s; look at the tree and search
Press Enter in the title field
expected: Empty title falls back to 'Untitled' (display and/or persisted); Enter moves the caret into the body
actual: PATCH /meta saves title '' and the tree row renders only an icon (blank label) — unidentifiable, and unfindable via search. Enter keeps focus in the title input.
suggestedFix: Render `title || 'Untitled'` (tertiary colour) in tree/search/breadcrumb and trim on save (or persist 'Untitled' when empty on blur); onKeyDown Enter -> editor.commands.focus('start').

title: Docs page delete uses native window.confirm (tree + editor), doesn't mention subpages that are deleted too, and offers no undo
repro: Install dialog spy; Docs > hover a page row > Delete (trash)
Docs > open a page > editor header 'Delete page'
Delete a page that has subpages (e.g. QA-q9-parent)
expected: Kit confirm dialog (role=dialog, Esc/Enter, focus return) naming the page and the number of subpages that will also be deleted; an Undo toast (backend POST /pages/:id/restore already exists)
actual: Native dialogs: spy log ['confirm: Delete "Untitled"?'] from the tree and ['confirm: Delete this page?'] from the editor (inconsistent copy). softDeletePage also soft-deletes all children silently. No undo/trash UI.
suggestedFix: Use the shared ConfirmDialog kit with one copy ('Delete "<title>" and N subpages?'); after delete show a notice with Undo calling api.restorePage (restore children too).

title: Merely opening a page (first after load / new page) writes it back: spurious PATCH bumps revision and 'edited' time
repro: GET /api/modules/knowledge/pages/5bec1891… -> updated_at 10:17:51, revision 7
Reload, open Docs, click QA-q9-mention-target, do not type, wait 2.5 s
GET again

actual: A PATCH /content is sent without user input (also right after creating a page): updated_at -> 10:44:45, revision 7 -> 8, 'Saved' pill flashes and the page shows 'edited just now'. With pages being edited by the assistant/MCP concurrently this can trigger conflicts or overwrite normalisation-only differences.

network: #293 PATCH /pages/49a03725…/content 200 right after GET, no typing
dark session #294 PATCH /pages/5bec1891…/content 200 right after POST /pages

codeRefs.note: onUpdate fires for the initial mount/normalisation transaction and is forwarded to autosave

suggestedFix: Ignore updates until the editor has been initialised with the page content (flag set after onCreate + first setContent) or compare editor JSON with the last saved JSON before triggerSave; only save on transactions with docChanged && !tr.getMeta('addToHistory')===false from user input.

title: Right-click in the Docs editor shows only the app menu ('Settings') — no Cut/Copy/Paste or spelling suggestions

expected: Native/text context menu with Cut, Copy, Paste, Select all and spell-check suggestions inside contenteditable/inputs
actual: data-testid=app-context-menu opens with a single item 'Settings Ctrl+,'. Text editing via mouse (paste from context menu, accept spelling suggestion — the editor does show spell-check squiggles) is impossible. Same in the title and search inputs.
suggestedFix: In the AppShell contextmenu handler return early (let the native menu show) when the target is inside input/textarea/[contenteditable] or has a selection; in Electron wire webContents 'context-menu' to a Cut/Copy/Paste/spellcheck menu.

title: Undo after switching pages pastes the previous page's content into the current page and autosaves it (history shared across pages)
repro: Docs > open QA-q9-sample-md, type ' mdedit' at the end, wait for Saved
Click QA-q9-sample-txt (content 'Plain text QA sample.')
Click into its body and press Cmd+Z (or the toolbar Undo, which is enabled)
Wait 1.5 s; GET /api/modules/knowledge/pages/876ec896…
expected: Undo history is per page; on a freshly opened page Undo is disabled/no-op
actual: First Cmd+Z replaces the txt page body with the md page's content ('QA sample / Some markdown text. / item 1 / item 2 / mdedit'); second Cmd+Z undoes 'mdedit'. Autosave then PATCHes that into QA-q9-sample-txt: its stored content is now the markdown document — original text 'Plain text QA sample.' overwritten. The same Tiptap instance is reused across pages and setContent() is recorded in history. (QA page restored afterwards with Cmd+Shift+Z twice; a real user would not know to do that.)

codeRefs.note: setContent(newData, { emitUpdate:false }) on page switch — goes into the undo stack
TiptapEditor not keyed by page id, so one editor/history serves every page

suggestedFix: Key the editor by page: <TiptapEditor key={page.id} …/> (fresh editor + history per page), or when switching call setContent with addToHistory:false via a transaction setMeta('addToHistory', false) and then clear history (recreate EditorState). Add a regression test: switch page, Cmd+Z must not change content.
